_comment: Plugins kept out of the catalog feed, by name. kind is one of builtin-overlap, claude-code-only, cursor-only, partner-gated, auth-unsupported, endpoint-unusable; auth-unsupported and endpoint-unusable are held back until fixed (tracked in corepasshq/remy docs/debt/2026-09-28-plugin-mcp-compatibility.md); reason says why, in a sentence a reviewer can check. Read by scripts/generate_catalog_seed.py --exclusions in corepasshq/remy; the feed carries the list as `excluded`, and user-center freezes an excluded row with reason EXCLUDED (and thaws it when the entry leaves this list).

browser-use.reason: Remy's built-in browser and Chrome plugins already drive a real browser.

chrome-devtools-mcp.reason: Remy's built-in Chrome/CDP plugins already inspect and control a live Chrome.

claude-code-setup.reason: Recommends and writes Claude Code automations, and shells out to the claude CLI.

security-guidance.reason: Its LLM diff review runs on the Claude Agent SDK with Claude credentials.

project-artifact.reason: Generates and publishes its status page through the claude CLI.

mcp-tunnels.reason: Drives Anthropic's MCP tunnel product, which needs an Anthropic API key.

cursor-sdk.reason: Skills for building on the Cursor SDK.

orchestrate.reason: Fans work out to Cursor cloud agents through the Cursor SDK.

cursor-team-kit.reason: Cursor's internal engineering workflows (control-cli, their CI).

docs-canvas.reason: Renders documentation into Cursor's canvas surface.

pr-review-canvas.reason: Renders PR diffs into Cursor's canvas surface.

continual-learning.reason: Mines Cursor agent transcripts from a Cursor stop hook, which Remy does not fire.

skill-creator.reason: Remy ships its own skill-creator skill; this one also scores skills by shelling out to the claude CLI.

code-review.reason: Remy's built-in code-review skill already reviews a change with specialised passes.

dash0.reason: OpenTelemetry for Claude Code sessions; ten of the 24 hook events it traces are ones Remy does not fire.

remember.reason: Builds its memory from Claude Code transcripts and summarises them with the claude CLI.

session-report.reason: Reports on Claude Code session logs under ~/.claude/projects.

receipts.reason: Mines Claude Code transcripts for its usage report.

langfuse-observability.reason: Exports Claude Code transcripts (the hook's transcript_path) to Langfuse; Remy hands hooks no transcript.

ralph-loop.reason: Its loop is a Stop hook that re-reads the Claude Code transcript, which Remy does not hand to hooks.

advisor.reason: Runs on Cursor hook events (afterFileEdit, afterAgentResponse, stop) and a Grok-pinned Cursor subagent.

pstack.reason: A workflow kit built around Cursor automations, cursor-agent worktrees and Cursor subagents; only its principle notes work elsewhere.

adobe-for-creativity.reason: Its MCP server (adobe-creativity.adobe.io/mcp) answers every non-partner client 403 with no auth challenge, with or without a valid Adobe token; Adobe ships it to Claude as a partner connector, and its skills only drive that server.

docusign.reason: Its MCP server (mcp.docusign.com/mcp) answers every request 'RBAC: access denied' at the gateway, and its authorization server offers no client registration.

finance.reason: Its MCP server lives on Grok's connector gateway (connectors-gateway.grok.com), which refuses every other client with 403.

onedrive.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth).

outlook.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth).

outlook-calendar.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth).

sharepoint.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth).

teams.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth).

google-docs.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth); its one skill only drives that server.

google-sheets.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth); its one skill only drives that server.

google-slides.reason: Its MCP server is api.cursor.com/rest-mcp, which requires a Cursor credential (x-cursor-auth); its one skill only drives that server.

figma.reason: Its authorization server refuses dynamic client registration with 403 Forbidden for every client; Figma admits only approved MCP clients.

box.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

hubspot.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

hubspot-sales.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

x.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

x-ads.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

x-money.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

zoom.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

sumup.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

bigdata-com.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

amazon-selling-partner.reason: Its MCP server needs a vendor-registered OAuth app: its authorization server offers no dynamic client registration and the plugin ships no client id.

revenuecat.reason: Its dynamic client registration answers invalid_client: the client is not registered, contact support.

rc.reason: Same MCP server as revenuecat, whose dynamic client registration answers invalid_client: contact support.

similarweb.reason: Its dynamic client registration endpoint answers every request 403 at CloudFront.

gamma.reason: Its dynamic client registration rejects every redirect URI tried (localhost, 127.0.0.1, https, custom schemes): a fixed allowlist of partner clients.

gong.reason: Its dynamic client registration accepts only an https redirect with a confidential client (token_endpoint_auth_method none is unsupported); needs an Edge-held client and https callback relay.

etoro-trading.reason: Its dynamic client registration accepts only a cursor:// redirect URI; loopback and https are rejected.

mongodb-atlas.reason: Its client id is Claude Code's Client ID Metadata Document; Remy does not sign in under another product's identity. Needs Remy's own CIMD (or a MongoDB-registered client).

slack.reason: It ships Slack's client id registered for Claude Code; Remy does not sign in under another product's identity, and Slack offers no dynamic registration. Needs a Remy Slack app.

zoom-plugin.reason: Its seven MCP servers take Zoom user OAuth access tokens pasted into settings (they expire hourly); mcp.zoom.us offers no dynamic registration, so a usable sign-in needs a Remy Zoom app. Claude uses its own directory connector instead.

cloudinary.reason: Four of its five MCP servers are standard OAuth and work, but cloudinary-mediaflows ships literal header values (cloud_name, api_key, api_secret) that no user setting can replace, and an unavailable server blocks every send that references the plugin.

blackrock-advisor-center-plugin.reason: Its MCP server answers an Akamai 'Access Denied' page; possibly an IP or region block.

rill.reason: Its MCP URL is a local Rill Developer server (localhost:9009).

vanguard-advisor-tools.reason: Its MCP URL redirects to a not-found page.

qt-development-skills.reason: Its MCP server answers the MCP initialize request with 400.

pigment.reason: Its MCP URL holds a literal {your-mcp-id} placeholder.

render.reason: It ships the client id 'claude', registered for Claude; Remy does not sign in under another product's identity, and Render offers no dynamic registration. Needs a Remy Render app.
